text.text_excerpt: omg SO good. i ordered a falafel platter and large french fries. the spicy sauce that was drizzled on the falafel was so yummy. the falafels were fresh, hot, and crispy, and perfectly seasoned. the beet salad was fresh and crispy. the hummus was falvorful. omg so good! i also liked the vegan garlic spread that came with the fries and platter. i will definitely go back. i used to eat a lot of falafel when i lived in the bay area. finally i've had comparable falafel! mona's, lebanon's, pyramids are just mediocre.

Probably my favorite food truck in New Orleans. And there are a lot of good ones here, so that's saying a lot! They keep it simple. You get your choice of falafel in a pita or falafel not in a pita, with or without fries. Get the fries. They top them with a garlicky sauce that is SO GOOD I find myself compulsively licking the bag they come in whenever I get them. No shame. None at all. The carrot/beet slaw is always so perfectly crisp and fresh. Everything they make is perfectly crisp and fresh. The falafel itself is exactly the way it should be - crisp-chewy on the outside, soft and seasoned on the inside. Oh man where have you been! Had some grub from here today at the central city food truck round up. It was so damn good I had to come home and write a review. The falafel has a great flavor and is very crunchy. Oh and the fries... Perfect is the only way to describe them especially with the garlic sauce (and I usually don't eat french fries). I have nothing bad to say about this place except I wish they were always parked right outside my front door! Oh well, I will just have to stumble across them when I do and put myself into a pita coma
